records.title: Energy-security response to Iran war could cut oil demand by 4% by 2035, IEA says
records.claim: The Reuters report records IEA’s ARC scenario: 2035 oil demand 4.4 million b/d below STEPS and cumulative Gulf losses of 2.8 billion barrels of oil and 60 bcm of gas.
records.boundary: Reuters confirms the event and reported figures; scenario interpretation anchored in IEA source.
records.support_excerpt: Reuters lines 167-179: ARC oil demand 4.4 million barrels per day lower than STEPS; cumulative Gulf losses 2.8 billion barrels and 60 bcm.

records.title: Executive summary - World Energy Outlook 2026
records.claim: IEA’s ARC explores the possibility that prolonged energy-security risks prompt additional measures; under ARC, oil demand in 2035 is more than 4 mb/d below STEPS and LNG demand is hit.
records.boundary: IEA official executive summary; page publication date is 19 Nov, time not displayed.
records.support_excerpt: IEA Executive Summary lines 81-84 and 106-108: ARC explores additional responses if risks persist; oil use by 2035 more than 4 mb/d lower than STEPS.

records.boundary: Reuters timestamps the approval event within the report window; does not replace FERC order.
records.support_excerpt: Reuters lines 167-179: approved the three-train expansion; Phase 1 expected to add more than 6 mtpa.

records.boundary: Industry view is attributed to Center for LNG; not evidence that contracts have already been signed.

records.title: Methane regulation: EU agrees targeted amendment to safeguard security of supply
records.claim: Council states importers’ monitoring, reporting and verification obligations move from 1 January 2027 to 1 January 2029; methane-intensity reporting moves from 5 August 2028 to 5 August 2030.
records.boundary: Council page shows 03:45 but no timezone; Reuters gives exact in-window timestamp for same agreement.
records.support_excerpt: Council lines 44-53: importer MRV from 1 January 2029 instead of 2027; methane-intensity reporting from 5 August 2030 instead of 2028; provisional agreement requires formal endorsement.

records.title: Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report
records.claim: EIA reports Lower 48 working gas storage of 3,882 Bcf for the week ending 13 November, a 20 Bcf weekly injection, 80 Bcf above the five-year average and 66 Bcf below year-ago levels.
records.boundary: EIA release time 10:30 a.m. Eastern; 19 Nov is EST (UTC-5), converted to 15:30 UTC. Single official storage dataset.
records.support_excerpt: EIA weekly storage report: released November 19 at 10:30 a.m.; working gas 3,882 Bcf, net increase 20 Bcf, 80 Bcf above five-year average.

records.title: Natural Gas futures retreat from 200-day average on 20 Bcf build.
